questions: Q1: Should the CLI add GOAL to VALID_MODES or create a new command namespace?

answers.answer: New command namespace (hlx goals). Goals are a separate entity (user decision), not a TicketMode. VALID_MODES (create.ts:13) stays at 5 values. A new src/goals/ directory mirrors the src/tickets/ pattern with create, list, get, terminate subcommands. Registered as a top-level command family in src/index.ts.
evidence: ticket.md: 'goals can be their own thing. They don't need to be tickets'
src/tickets/ directory: established pattern for command family structure
diagnosis/diagnosis-statement.md (CLI): 'New src/goals/ directory with create, list, get, terminate subcommands'

statement: The CLI needs a new hlx goals command family (create, list, get, terminate) in a new src/goals/ directory, mirroring the src/tickets/ pattern. VALID_MODES is unchanged since Goals are a separate entity, not a TicketMode. All commands call server /api/goals endpoints.
